method: read original publisher main articles and verify quoted mechanisms, dates and caveats

source_evidence.scope: Entire GitHub publisher two-minute article: preview surfaces, Cascade judge repair, Critique tools, model effort and policy availability.
main_facts: HydraFusion preview spans multiple Copilot surfaces.
Cascade can invoke review-based repair; Critique explores workspace evidence.
limitations: Research preview; no independent reliability benchmark.

source_evidence.scope: Entire two-minute GitHub original article including lockfile generation, SHA pinning, reusable actions, status checks and Dependabot update.
main_facts: actions.lock can pin direct/transitive workflow dependencies.
Dependabot can propose audited dependency updates.
limitations: SHA immutability is not a code safety guarantee.

source_evidence.scope: Full AWS walkthrough describing Strands supervisor, retrieval, embeddings, S3, OpenSearch, guardrails, PPTX creation and annual report example.
main_facts: Supervisor dispatches summarization and presentation generation.
RAG grounds slide statements in retrieved source passages.
limitations: Demonstration throughput is illustrative, not an independent productivity measurement.

source_evidence.scope: Full publisher technical implementation: document classification, eight agents, Textract, Aurora DSQL validation, instruction-fixer loop and repeat-path timings.
main_facts: Failed extraction checks can revise stored instructions.
Validation requires explicit field rules and available ground truth.

source_evidence.scope: Original GitHub four-minute permission release covering scoped create/install access, approval and offline credential improvements.
main_facts: GitHub introduced narrower App permission scopes.
Organizational controls still require explicit approval.
limitations: The Agent Skill procedure is original editorial teaching material; not a vendor-released Skill.

source_evidence.scope: Full original case study covering Slack triage, scoped knowledge sources, screenshot support, user Jira escalation and case-study measurements.
main_facts: Knowledge retrieval is scoped to authorized support context.
Jira ticket escalation includes user choice and structured validation.
limitations: Reported response rates must not be described as resolutions; metrics come from vendor/customer narrative.
